results.rationale: Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission.
CO-PROFILE does not evidence PEC registration in category C-B or higher (and explicitly lists PEC constructor registration as not held).
CO-PROFILE explicitly states ISO 14001 is not held, so the mandatory ISO 14001 requirement is not met.
CO-PROFILE shows average annual turnover of PKR 900M, which is below the required PKR 2,500M over the last three audited years.
No CAP record demonstrates completion of a safe-city/surveillance/integrated security project as prime contractor with value ≥ PKR 1,500M.
Neither CO-PROFILE nor CAP summaries provide evidence of owning or having assured access to trenching/boring/pole-installation machinery within 50 km of Islamabad.
CO-PROFILE confirms the company holds ISO 27001, meeting the mandatory information security certification requirement.
CO-PROFILE confirms ability to arrange a CDR/bank guarantee and shows a PKR 100M facility, covering the required PKR 44M bid security.
